text:
Maya: Quick question for the watercooler: if one mundane office object had to be the official 'guardian spirit' of our workspace, which would you pick and what single superpower would it have? Keep it silly. 

Lev: The whiteboard eraser. Power: erases all meeting agenda items that are longer than 3 bullets. :wastebasket:

Noor: The lonely plant in the lobby. Power: can revive only one lost email thread per week. :herb:

Ethan: The thermostat. Power: emits an aura that convinces people to bring snacks on Thursdays. :icecream:

Maya: The old projector remote. Power: pauses awkward silence and auto-plays a joke video. :clapper:

ops-bot: ops-bot: FYI environmental note 9994 00 0 0 Thermostat logged an 0.3B decrease after suggestion. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

Lev: Also vote: if the plant wins, we rename it 'Sir Chlorophyll' and assign it an email alias. :seedling:

Noor: If the eraser wins, mandatory whiteboard confetti on every sprint demo. 

Ethan: I nominate the sticky-note dispenser. Power: instantly generates a polite excuse for being 5 minutes late. `Sorry, snagged by a spontaneous empathy circle.`

Maya: Can we make this a weekly tradition? Next week: choose the official office anthem. :musical_note:
